summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of Jobsboats MVP. Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (health, stats, jobs+filters, auth register/login/me/logout, profile, employer job posting + RBAC, applications dedup + stage progression new->shortlisted->interview->offered->hired, saved jobs save/list/unsave, alerts CRUD). Frontend: all critical flows pass via Playwright - Home hero+search, navbar nav, /jobs filters & job-detail side sheet, register with role toggle (seeker/employer + company field), demo login redirects (seeker->/dashboard, employer->/employer with 5-stage Kanban), seeker tabs (Recommended/Saved/Applied/Alerts) + create/delete alert, profile edit persists headline/location, logout clears session, /random-route shows 404 page.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True in starlette CORSMiddleware. Browsers ignore credentials with wildcard origin. Works today because frontend & backend share the same external host through ingress, but recommended to set explicit origins.

design_issues.screen: Job detail sheet / Post job dialog
issues: Radix DialogContent / SheetContent missing aria-describedby - console warning only, not a blocker but should add Description for a11y

action_items: Optional: replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with explicit production origin when credentials are enabled.
Optional: add DialogDescription / SheetDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression) to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is one 700-line module - consider splitting into routers (auth, jobs, applications, saved, alerts, seed) as it grows.
Seeded employer is only linked to Harbor Labs jobs; other seed jobs have employer_id=null which means they are invisible to the employer pipeline. Intended for demo, document if not.
ApplicationStageUpdate accepts 'rejected' stage but Kanban only has 5 stages (new/shortlisted/interview/offered/hired) - rejected stage cards won't appear anywhere in the UI.
Resume upload only stores filename, no actual file storage. Acknowledged in problem statement.
test_credentials: Demo seeker: seeker@jobsboats.com/seeker123. Demo employer: employer@jobsboats.com/employer123. Both seeded via startup hook (idempotent).
seed_data_creation: Backend automatically seeds 12 jobs + 2 demo users on startup. Tests created TEST_-prefixed users and one TEST_Job_* job posting. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - run via 'pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v'. All endpoints prefixed /api. JWT delivered via httpOnly cookie 'access_token' (also accepts Authorization: Bearer). Use requests.Session() to preserve cookie between calls. Kanban data-testid is only rendered when employer has applications (>=1) - the empty-state path renders an Empty card instead. data-testid coverage is excellent across components.
